### Added

- (muster) [MCP sign-in notice on every page, with a sign-in dialog](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3004) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow) — Where the Agent Platform is on, a card in the bottom right of every page says which MCP servers still need your sign-in or grant. `Sign in` opens a dialog to finish each of them, and `Not now` hides the card for the browser session. Covers the home installation's muster.

### Fixed

- (agent-platform) [Name the platform team when Installations is off](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2999) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow) — On a portal without the Installations page, the `kagent is not installed` card says to `ask your platform team to enable the Agent Platform` instead of pointing at a page the person cannot open.
- (muster) [Never forward an expired Dex ID token; refresh or ask to sign in again](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2992) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow) — A tab left open past the sign-in token's lifetime no longer shows muster's raw `token has expired … re-authenticate` errors. The portal refreshes the session before the token lapses, and when it cannot, shows `Your session expired, sign in again.` with `Sign in again`.
- (ui-react) [Keep a tab's width while its count loads and arrives](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3002) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians) — Tabs with a count, on Customize, a connector's Tools and a skill's Used by, no longer shift sideways when their numbers load, so a click no longer lands on the neighbouring tab. A placeholder holds each number's place.


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/compare/v3.2.0...v3.3.0
